links.outcome: Deidentification pipeline sensitivity and precision against manually adjudicated entities
links.effect: Validated against 110 manually adjudicated entities: sensitivity 95.1%, precision 82.1%, so some identifiers were missed.
links.quote: Personal health information partial masking was applied across the corpus using a deidentification pipeline validated against 110 manually adjudicated entities (sensitivity 95.1%, precision 82.1%).

screen.reason: The paper reports on the design and validation of a secure sandbox UI and de-identification pipeline for offline preclinical testing and evaluation of LLMs on patient portal messages.
